name: cc-wrap-up
description: Cues a wrap-up at a natural break in a long session, then compacts with better-compact's message or hands off with handoff's resume prompt, with no copy-paste. At 900k tokens it stops a turn still running and runs better-compact by itself, before auto-compaction does.

startTokens.title: Start watching at (tokens)
startTokens.description: Context size where the mod starts watching for a natural break (a commit or a clean tree) to offer a wrap-up.

stepTokens.title: Step (tokens)
stepTokens.description: How far Later moves the line, and how long the mod waits for a natural break before it offers the wrap-up anyway.

urgentTokens.title: Urgent at (tokens)
urgentTokens.description: Context size where the offer turns urgent and sends a notification. Auto-compaction runs at 967k on a 1M window, with no audit.

autoTokens.title: Wrap up by itself at (tokens)
autoTokens.description: Context size where the mod stops a running turn and runs better-compact by itself, then compacts and resumes the task. 0 turns this off.
